scripts.deploy:ios: [ -z "${APPLE_TEAM_ID}" ] && echo 'Error: APPLE_TEAM_ID not set. Create .env.local first.' && exit 1; [ -z "${IOS_DEVICE_UDID}" ] && echo 'Error: IOS_DEVICE_UDID not set. Create .env.local first.' && exit 1; cap sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath /tmp/mobile-app-build DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=${APPLE_TEAM_ID} CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY='Apple Development' CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic -quiet && xcrun devicectl device install app --device ${IOS_DEVICE_UDID} /tmp/mobile-app-build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/App.app
scripts.deploy:ios:release: [ -z "${APPLE_TEAM_ID}" ] && echo 'Error: APPLE_TEAM_ID not set. Create .env.local first.' && exit 1; [ -z "${IOS_DEVICE_UDID}" ] && echo 'Error: IOS_DEVICE_UDID not set. Create .env.local first.' && exit 1; cap sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath /tmp/mobile-app-build-release DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=${APPLE_TEAM_ID} CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY='Apple Development' CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic -quiet && xcrun devicectl device install app --device ${IOS_DEVICE_UDID} /tmp/mobile-app-build-release/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/App.app
scripts.archive:ios: [ -z "${APPLE_TEAM_ID}" ] && echo 'Error: APPLE_TEAM_ID not set. Create .env.local first.' && exit 1; cap sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath /tmp/mobile-app.xcarchive DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=${APPLE_TEAM_ID} CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY='Apple Distribution' CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath /tmp/mobile-app.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist ios/App/ExportOptions.plist -exportPath /tmp/mobile-app-ipa
scripts.upload:ios: [ -z "${APPLE_ID}" ] && echo 'Error: APPLE_ID not set. Create .env.local first.' && exit 1; xcrun altool --upload-app -f /tmp/mobile-app-ipa/App.ipa -t ios -u ${APPLE_ID}
